_documentation: Lighthouse CI assertion config for .github/workflows/lighthouse.yml (#270). Category thresholds sit below the day-to-day scores on purpose: the gate exists to catch collapses (a 1 MB image landing on a page, a render-blocking regression), not to flake on shared-runner variance. resource-summary:image:size warns when any audited page ships more than 500 KB of images, the exact class of regression the June 2026 press-kit fix removed. The workflow is not a required check, so a red run signals without blocking auto-merge.
